Leah (AE): Quick thread  GovClient wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. Must haves: customer-held signing key option, SBOM + provenance, manual-only upgrades, a 1-page ops runbook, and predictable maintenance windows. Procurement refuses monthly invoices. Kickoff Thurs.
Marco (SE): Noted. Need target model size & quantization. If they pick 7B q4, model ~600MB; 13B q4 ~1.1GB. Runtime adds ~300-400MB. Shipping method (USB vs jumpbox) affects ETA.
Priyanka (Infra Eng): We support customer-managed signing keys. Two flows: customer signs artifacts locally (we verify), or we pre-sign if they allow. If customer keeps keys offline, we'll need an OOB handshake (on-site or pre-signed fingerprint exchange). Root CA rotations are manual.
Dan (Solutions Eng): Commercially we can present 2 options that avoid monthly invoices: (A) Annual subscription + reserved capacity invoiced annually with X minibundles included; (B) Perpetual license + annual maintenance invoiced annually + per-bundle engineering. Add-on: paid remote assist installs.
Leah (AE): Procurement asks exact calendar anchors. They want precise days for maintenance windows so they can schedule change freezes. Can we give calendar rules?
Marco (SE): Yes. Recommend "first Wednesday each month" for security patches and "first Tuesday of each quarter" for model refreshes. For air-gapped flow we prepare signed minibundles 3 business days before window. Customer applies manually.
Priyanka (Infra Eng): Technical caveats to call out: bandwidth for >1GB artifacts; operator must have sudo during install; if they manage signing keys, we need Legal + HSM checklist; delta minibundles reduce transfer time but require compatibility testing with their pinned runtime.
Dan (Solutions Eng): SBOM/provenance: we provide SPDX SBOMs and a provenance CSV with artifact name, sha256, sbom file, signer fingerprint. We'll include sample lines in the questionnaire response.
Leah (AE): They also require telemetry off by default. Is that supported?
Marco (SE): Yes. Telemetry can be disabled. Tradeoff: limited remote diagnostics; we offer paid remote-assist sessions for installs/troubleshooting. We'll document that.
pkg-bot: Ticket SALES-6789 created: "GovClient airgap POC - key custody, cadence & billing" assigned to Marco, Dan.
Dan (Solutions Eng): Action: I'll draft two commercial sketches + SOW language with calendar anchors by Tue EOD. Marco: please provide minibundle size table and a one-page runbook snippet. Priyanka: prepare HSM & key-onboarding checklist for Legal (ETA 48h).
Marco (SE): Will include sample CLI: `./rw-offline verify --bundle /mnt/usb/minibundle.tar.gz && ./rw-offline apply --bundle /mnt/usb/minibundle.tar.gz` and a small table for install times on 10/50/100Mbps links.
Leah (AE): Great. I'll consolidate and send to GovClient. Flag blockers ASAP. :white_check_mark:
